name: octo-travel-app
description: A local-first travel planner with an optional AI itinerary assistant.

scripts.build: wrangler pages functions build functions --outdir .wrangler/functions-build --project-directory . --build-output-directory public
scripts.check: npm run syntax && npm run typecheck && npm run build
scripts.deploy: npm run check && wrangler pages deploy public --project-name octo-travel-app --branch main
